item.title: Speaking the Truth in Love
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains what it means to speak the truth in love from Ephesians 4:15. This episode explores biblical accuracy, Christlike tone, pursuing the spiritual good of others, and why faithfulness may still lead to misunderstanding or rejection.

item.title: Job 28: Where True Wisdom Is Found
item.description: In Job 28, Scripture asks where true wisdom can be found. This episode explains that wisdom belongs to God alone and begins with the fear of the Lord.
